combats.encounter: Hobgoblin portal company and one-armed wizard

entries.summary: Casts a 20-foot-diameter Wall of Fire, damaging inward. The captain and one soldier fail Dexterity saves and take 29 fire damage; the soldier dies. Iascaire then moves.
Attempts Counterspell against the fourth-level Wall of Fire, fails the DC 14 ability check, and the wall appears.
Casts Fly and rises 60 feet straight up.
One soldier runs through the fire and dies. Two others remain inside and burn up at the end of their turns. The lieutenant exits and survives; another soldier was outside the circle.
Moves toward melee and dashes to reach the indicated position.
Runs through the wall, takes fire damage, and moves near the wizard; the damage total is not stated.

Cannot get directly beneath the wizard for Banishment. Casts Fly instead and flies diagonally toward him, ending about 40 feet up. Eldritch Blast is withdrawn because Fly used the action; Hexblade’s Curse is out of range.
Drops concentration on Wall of Fire while Delwath moves, preventing him from being burned.
Closes beside an ally and attacks Aristaea three times: 16 misses, 25 hits for a stated 17 damage, and 15 misses; the hit is explicitly not critical.
entries.note: The closing words “25 total” are ambiguous after the earlier explicit 17 damage; no replacement damage total is inferred.

entries.summary: Moves and directs the wildfire spirit toward a reachable enemy. No other completed personal spell is recorded in this turn.
Moves and hits the map-indicated hobgoblin with Flame Seed for a corrected 9 fire damage.
entries.note: The pointed-at enemy is not verbally identified; the wizard is still 60 feet up.

entries.summary: Casts Fireball between Delwath and Aristaea: both fail Dexterity saves. Delwath takes 30 fire damage; Aristaea takes 15 with fire resistance. The wizard flies 20 feet across and 40 feet higher. Delwath maintains Fly.
Swings at Aristaea and misses.
First attack misses the warlord/captain. Her second pike attack hits and she adds a smite for a stated 8 damage; weapon damage is not voiced.
Moves up and attacks Aristaea twice with a greatsword. Both hit, at 21 and 20, for 23 and 13 damage respectively.

Flies 60 feet toward the wizard, reaching about 100 feet high and 20 feet from him. Applies Hexblade’s Curse; Eldritch Blast misses at 14, then hits at 23 for 11 damage including the curse bonus. A wizard concentration check is requested without a spoken result; his continued flight confirms it holds.
Attacks Aristaea three times: a natural 1 misses, the second misses, and the third hits for 21 damage, knocking her unconscious.
Changes the proposed Healing Word to fifth-level Cure Wounds originating from the wildfire spirit. Aristaea regains 38 hit points and wakes; Iascaire also moves.

Moves beside Aristaea and teleports her 15 feet toward the portal. Of three hobgoblins, the middle one succeeds on its Dexterity save; the other two fail and take 9 fire damage. The sergeant dies and a soldier is wounded; the captain rallies the survivor.

Circles back toward his allies and climbs to 130 feet, then casts Lightning Bolt at Delwath. Delwath succeeds on the Dexterity save, taking 16 lightning damage from 33. A concentration check is rolled; continued flight confirms Fly remains active.
Charges Aristaea and rolls a natural 20; adamantine armor prevents doubled critical damage, leaving 5 damage.
Closes into melee at altitude, hits the wizard for 14 damage, and misses the second attack. The wizard succeeds on his concentration save. Delwath casts Sanctuary as a bonus action.
entries.note: Aristaea’s intervening turn discusses Lay on Hands, but the source supplies no completed action or healing value for her.

entries.summary: Closes on Aristaea and makes three attacks: 18 misses, then two hits deal 23 and 6 damage.
Casts third-level Heat Metal on the large plate-armored warlord, imposing disadvantage on all attacks. No damage total is spoken. Moves again after arranging Aristaea’s withdrawal.
Teleports Aristaea 15 feet back, placing the spirit between her and the enemies. Both pursuing hobgoblins fail Dexterity saves and take 7 fire damage.

Casts Thunderwave. An initial Sanctuary objection is reversed because the spell targets Self; Delwath succeeds on the Constitution save with advantage and takes 9 damage, without the intended push. The wizard starts moving away, then continues to a final position about 30 feet across and 50 feet down, 80 feet above the ground.
Takes an opportunity attack during the wizard’s retreat, rolls 12, and misses; the wizard continues his descent.
Closes and hits Aristaea with another natural 20. Adamantine armor again negates critical doubling; she takes 3 damage.
Kills the wounded soldier with her first pike hit, withdrawing the unnecessary smite. Moves to the heated warlord and kills him with the second attack.

Pursues the wizard to 80 feet and hits for a corrected 24 damage, replacing 13 after adding the forgotten extra d8. The wizard rolls a natural 1 on his concentration save, loses Fly, falls 80 feet for 32 damage, and dies before Delwath’s second attack.

ending.summary: The ground troops and officers are dead; the wizard loses Fly and dies on hitting the shadow plane’s ground.

combats.note: Officer titles shift between lieutenant, captain, sergeant and warlord. Greatsword officer and longsword warlord distinguish the two resolved combat roles without inventing personal names.

entries.summary: Already flying, dashes 120 feet just above the ground and across difficult terrain toward the warlock.
Draw their swords and wait.
Dashes forward through the air.
Likewise dashes forward through the air.
Casts a poisonous mist, later identified as Cloudkill. Its damage applies when targets start their turns inside it.
Five arrows hit Aristaea for a corrected 5 piercing damage. Five more target Delwath but miss at 18 against AC 20.

Makes a ranged spell attack against Iascaire, initially a natural 20. Aristaea invokes a blessing to cancel the critical; Iascaire takes 15 necrotic damage and a skeletal hand prevents him from regaining hit points.
At initiative count 20, six more skeletons emerge; the DM supplies this missed occurrence retrospectively before combining them into a bone swarm.

Succeeds on a Constitution save against Cloudkill, taking 10 poison damage rather than 5 because he began outside Aristaea’s aura; maintains Fly. Flies 60 feet to the warlock and lands, applies Hexblade’s Curse, and hits twice for 15 and 24 damage. The warlock succeeds on both concentration checks.
Targets Delwath with green miasma; 17 misses and has no effect.
Attack Delwath collectively; 27 hits for 7 piercing plus 5 necrotic damage. Two others remain stationary.

Makes a Constitution save against Cloudkill and takes 16 poison damage; the initially stated poisoned condition is explicitly withdrawn. Moves before casting as permitted, then raises an outward-damaging Wall of Fire, destroying the intersected minions. Remains airborne outside the wall.
Moves and teleports to the indicated side rather than making the contemplated ranged attack.
Succeeds on her Constitution save against Cloudkill and takes 5 poison damage. Flies to hover 20 feet up above the wall and casts Moonbeam on the immobile warlock.

Succeeds on the Constitution save against Moonbeam, taking half radiant damage without apparent vulnerability, and maintains concentration. The cloud drifts 10 feet. Casts Fear: Aristaea is immune and Delwath succeeds on the Wisdom save, so it has no effect.
One half misses Iascaire with a natural 1; the other half hits Aristaea at 28 for 5 piercing damage.
At the end of the archers’ turn, the newly raised skeletons merge into a giant bone swarm, which is no longer a minion.
Hits the warlock for 20 damage and misses the second attack at 15. The cocoon holds the warlock in place but does not impose restrained or grant advantage.
Explodes a nearby skeleton. Delwath makes a Dexterity save and takes no damage; its shards reform the warlock’s bones, healing him by an unstated amount.
Close on Delwath and hit at 22 for 2 piercing or slashing damage plus 6 necrotic damage.

Flies to the archers and descends to an adjudicated 15 feet. Burning Hands catches four of five; all fail Dexterity saves and die. Their bones create difficult terrain below, irrelevant to those still flying.
Moves and uses Fiery Teleportation near the bone swarm. Its Dexterity roll is 10 and it takes a final stated 8 fire damage.

Descends to hover about 5–10 feet up and attacks downward. Her first pike attack kills two skeletons; the second hits the warlock at 19 and adds smite, with voiced rolls 7 and an extra 3 against undead. Weapon damage is not stated.
entries.note: The proposed additional exploding-skeleton legendary action at u2519–u2522 is withdrawn because the warlock has spent his legendary actions.

entries.summary: Fails his Constitution save against Moonbeam; the radiant damage total is not spoken. Is no longer concentrating on a spell after ineffective Fear. Casts an acid burst behind Delwath and Aristaea, calling for Dexterity saves: Aristaea takes 8 acid damage with her aura’s spell resistance; Delwath takes 17 acid plus 2 necrotic damage and is coated in acid for his next turn.
Moves to the wildfire spirit and hits AC 13 with a slam for 12 bludgeoning damage.

Move away from the wall and spirit. The spirit has no melee attack and makes no opportunity attack. Five archers roll a natural 20 against the spirit for 10 piercing damage; another six roll 8 and miss the party target indicated on the map.
More skeletons emerge before Delwath’s turn; their number is not stated.

Takes 12 acid damage at turn start, after which the coating ends. Confirms successful Fly concentration rolls of 13 and 15; he has advantage but need not reroll successful first dice. Hovers a few feet up within reach, retains Fly instead of Banishing Smite, hits for 22 damage, misses at 14, and casts Sanctuary as a bonus action.

After Delwath’s turn, releases a 30-foot-radius blast of thunder and necrotic energy. All three PCs fail Constitution saves. Iascaire takes 28 damage outside the aura; Delwath and Aristaea take 14 each through its spell resistance. Nearby minions are destroyed. Iascaire maintains Wall of Fire.
entries.note: The spirit’s exposure is left uncertain after the DM questions its range; it continues acting. The special action is not explicitly named legendary, lair or villain.

entries.summary: Moves down toward the ground and casts upcast Cure Wounds on Delwath for 26 healing, later adding 3 from the spirit, for 29 total. Iascaire’s own inability to heal remains in effect.

Moves into contact with the warlock and teleports 15 feet, using its fire immunity to occupy the wall. All indicated targets fail Dexterity saves: three minions die and the larger target takes 9 fire damage.
entries.note: The larger target is indicated on the map rather than named; contact with the warlock is stated immediately before the teleport.

entries.summary: First pike attack misses. The second hits and adds a third-level smite with the extra undead die. The DM ends the fight by declaring the warlock destroyed in radiant fire despite mentioning 68 hit points remaining; all other undead collapse. No invented damage total is assigned.

ending.summary: The DM declares Aristaea’s radiant pike strike destroys the warlock; every other undead collapses. The armband is destroyed after initiative and is not an extra combat turn.
